annotations.title: Singapore public holidays and working days

description: Singapore public holidays and working days for 2026 and 2027 (MOM data, including observed Monday holidays). Pass date alone to ask whether it is a public holiday or working day; from + add to get the date N working days later (negative N for earlier); from + to to count working days between two dates; or year to list that year's holidays. Weekends and public holidays are skipped. Each answer has as_of and the official source.

add.description: Working days to add to date (negative to go back). The start date is not counted.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Alone: is it a public holiday or working day? With add or to: the start date.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD end date: count working days from date to this date.

year.description: 2026 or 2027: list that year's public holidays.
